answer_1.quote: We apply our edit operation based model to five NLP tasks: text normalization, sentence fusion, sentence splitting & rephrasing, text simplification, and grammatical error correction (GEC).
answer_1.outputs: The model generates a sequence of edit operations (tag, span, replacement) that transform the source into the target sequence.

answer_2.quote: We report sentence error rates (SERs↓) for text normalization, SARI↑ scores ... for sentence fusion, splitting, and simplification, and ERRANT ... span-based P(recision)↑, R(ecall)↑, and F 0.5 -scores on the BEA development set for grammar correction.
